cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 1760: 30 displayed points from 176 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 1560–1760: all 21 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 123.535, interval [73.081, 173.455]. Paired change versus generation 1750: -18.087, 95% interval [-67.692, 39.883]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 22,528 games; 176 rated checkpoints. g1290 anchor 0.
